figurative_meaning_en: Extremely beautiful or handsome man or woman
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে খুবসুরৎ দেখতে, সকলে তার প্রতি আকৃষ্ট হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: She looks very beautiful, everyone is attracted to her.
The actress appears very beautiful in this picture.
history: This expression appears in Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay's novel 'Rajsingha', where it describes the character Rupnagarwali, highlighting beauty in 19th-century Bengali literature.
note: The variant 'খুপসুরৎ' may reflect dialectal or archaic pronunciation in older Bengali texts.
